payload.title: role routing on claude
payload.body: Claude Code has no host-configurable role aliases; an agent's 'model' accepts only an id, a tier alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or inherit. So the claude face of role routing maps each held role to a tier alias in the claude adapter: implementer to sonnet; planner, assayer and architect to opus. A tier alias still names no model version, so it degrades the concept rather than breaking it. Rectified: the table is justified by the role (spec-bounded unit work on the middle tier), matching the operator's omp config today, not copied from it; a host's override (e.g. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, or an install-time choice) stays the host's. Amends the role routing gloss, which today speaks only of alias entries. Correction from live probes: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL alone does not override a definition's model; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1 together with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL does.
